messages:
incident-bot: :warning: Real-time latency detector triggered for service=streaming-infer env=prod. p99=2.82s (SLO p99=1.0s). Affected region: us-west-2. Trigger: latency-detector-rt. Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/streaming-infer?p=rt

maria: I'm oncall — looking now. Paging SRE and runtime.

ryan: joining. I see a sharp tail-latency bump starting ~T-18m on the streaming endpoint. Throughput not spiking, error rate flat. Tail looks concentrated on a subset of hosts (ip range 10.12.*).

sam: quick check on recent deploys — model rollout to variant v1.4.2-quant started ~15m ago (canary 20%). I'll see if the canary expanded.

elena: support flagged an ACME customer ticket saying streaming responses stalled (they saw stream hang ~10-20s then resume). Ticket: SUP-4521.

maria: quick health checks:
```
# curl health
curl -sS https://streaming-infer.prod/health
{"status":"ok","uptime_s":123456}

# check pods
kubectl get pods -l app=streamer -o wide | grep us-west-2
streamer-aaa   Running   2/2   20m   10.12.4.11
streamer-bbb   Running   2/2   5m    10.12.6.23

# top
kubectl top pods -l app=streamer --containers
streamer-bbb   2500m cpu  11Gi mem
```

ryan: logs show repeated KV cache miss churn and `decode_time_ms` spikes on worker threads around the same timestamps:
```
[2026-03-15T12:08:21Z] worker-3 decode_time_ms=42 -> 420
[2026-03-15T12:08:22Z] kv_cache: miss tenant=acme key=... eviction=true
[2026-03-15T12:08:25Z] gpu_util: 98% (node 10.12.6.23)
```

sam: sounds like a model/runtime change increased per-token compute or memory pressure causing KV thrash. I'm pulling the model rollout config now.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: PD-INC-987 created and assigned to maria. Priority: P1.

maria: mitigation plan proposal (fast):
- raise autoscaler min for us-west-2 from 2 -> 4 to reduce per-node load
- force routing to stable model variant v1.4.1 for hosted pool (stop canary)
- throttle streaming sessions max_tokens to 512 for non-enterprise tenants
- open dedicated-customer escalation for the 3 customers reporting stalls

ryan: I'll scale first, executing:
```
kubectl patch hpa streaming-frontend -n prod --patch '{"spec": {"minReplicas": 4}}'
```
Scaling triggered, nodes provisioning (AWS ASG).

sam: found a suspicious runtime flag in v1.4.2: `--attention-chunking=false` that was removed in the build — re-enables chunking reduces per-token decode. Reproduced locally: decode_time per token ~3x without chunking.

dave: product note: the canary percentage was supposed to be 10%, not 20%. I'll check rollout automation.

elena: updating support: telling affected customers we have a mitigation in progress and will provide ETA ~30m.

maria: executing quick routing flip to stable for hosted: 
```
# route commands (internal)
redwoodctl rollout cancel --pool hosted --variant v1.4.2-quant
redwoodctl rollout promote --pool hosted --variant v1.4.1
```
sam: rollback initiated. New pods for v1.4.1 coming up (health checks passing).

ryan: after scaling and rollback start, infra metrics show p99 trending down:
- before: p99=2.82s
- +6m: p99=1.6s
- +12m: p99=0.95s

maria: good signal. We'll keep routing locked to stable for 30m, keep autoscaler min bumped, and leave token limit for non-enterprise. Sam, follow up on the attention-chunking change and why it shipped.

sam: root cause triage notes: model CI propagated a build with attention-chunking disabled due to a perf experiment patch that slipped through canary gating. Fix options: re-enable chunking (fast), or revert to v1.4.1 (done). Will prepare a test and lock the flag in CI.

elena: customer impact summary (initial): ~6-8% of streaming sessions experienced noticeable added latency; 3 Dedicated customers had partial stalls requiring session reconnects. No increase in 5xx observed. Escalations opened for those customers and SLO credit assessment started.

dave: action items for post-incident: rollback checklist, tighten canary percentage control, add attn-chunking smoke test in CI, update rollout automation to block unexpected canary percent increases.

pagerduty-bot: PD-INC-987 status: mitigation applied. Please update incident status in PD.

maria: handoff: I'm moving this to "watch" — mitigation success verified (p99 <= 1s after rollback). Owners:
- oncall: maria (monitoring)
- eng-runtime: sam (root cause)
- sre: ryan (capacity and autoscale tuning)
- support: elena (customer comms)
- product: dave (rollout/process)

maria: created incident ticket INC-2026 and a follow-up postmortem draft. Handoff to night oncall at 01:30 UTC with this thread and dashboard links. I'll post a summary to #postmortems once draft is ready.

ryan: leaving a watch note — will alert if p99 > 1.2s again.

sam: will push CI rollback guard and test by EOD.

elena: sending customer communique drafts to SRE/product for review.

maria: thanks everyone. Monitoring for 30m then move to post-incident. Closing active paging. :white_check_mark:
